proposition: He is carrying out Lord Harrow's order to bring Garr to the courtyard
quote: "This is enough," he said. "Captain Rowan—see that Garr is brought here. Take him from the yard to the courtyard. Let none hinder you."

proposition: He carries guilt for having carried out the order ('that he had answered an order; that the weight would remain')
quote: "Rowan stood with his head lowered. Later he would say what he had said here in smaller voice: that he had answered an order; that the weight would remain."
